gemini_description.purpose: To illustrate the electrical terminal wiring configurations (single-phase and three-phase delta/star) and schematic power supply circuits for single-phase and three-phase electric motors.
gemini_description.summary: This technical diagram provides connection details and electrical schematics for single-phase and three-phase electric motors. It teaches how to configure terminal jumpers for Delta (Δ) and Star (Y) winding connections on three-phase motors, how to wire an external starting/running capacitor on single-phase motors, and the typical line-power circuit protection and connection paths.

components.name: Capacitor (C)
components.description: An electrical component used in the single-phase motor configuration to shift phase and facilitate motor starting and running.

components.name: Terminal Block
components.description: The physical junction box connector array on the motor where line supply wires and jumper links are secured.

components.name: Delta (Δ) Jumper Bars
components.description: Three vertical metal link plates used to configure the three-phase motor windings in a Delta circuit.

components.name: Star (Y) Jumper Bar
components.description: A horizontal metal link plate used to short-circuit one side of the three-phase windings to form a Star neutral point.

components.name: Motor (M / M3)
components.description: The electric motor unit, shown either as a single-phase motor (M) with an internal heater (H) and capacitor (C), or a three-phase motor (M3).

components.name: Switch / Disconnector (S)
components.description: A control switch or contactor used to safely isolate or energize the motor circuit.

procedure: Identify the motor type (Single Phase vs. Three Phase) and match the supply voltage requirement.

For Single Phase Motors: Connect the incoming Line (L) and Neutral (N) lines to the corresponding terminal block screws, and wire the capacitor across the designated terminal terminals as detailed in the top-right terminal schematic.
For Three Phase Delta (Δ) Configuration: Install three vertical jumper bars across the top and bottom terminal rows, and connect phase lines L1, L2, and L3 to the bottom terminals.
For Three Phase Star (Y) Configuration: Install a horizontal jumper bar connecting all three top terminals together, and connect phase lines L1, L2, and L3 to the bottom three terminals.
For all configurations, ensure the safety ground wire is securely connected to the designated ground terminal.
Refer to the lower schematics to install system-level protection elements, such as inline fuses, thermal-magnetic circuit breakers, and isolation switches.

technical_details.detail: Single-phase supply uses Line (L/L1) and Neutral (N).
Three-phase supply uses Phase lines R, S, T (also designated as L1, L2, L3) along with a Neutral (N) line in some network types.
An internal heater (H) is integrated within the single-phase motor housing schematic to prevent moisture condensation when idle.
Protective grounding (earth symbol) is mandatory for both terminal box frames and electrical panel distribution systems.

warnings.warning: Ensure the correct jumper configuration (Delta vs. Star) is used to match the supply voltage, as incorrect configuration can result in motor failure or burnout.
Always verify that the grounding terminal is connected to an approved earth ground before energizing the circuit.
